claims.claim: Teamwork is destructive to workmanship because it relies on the division of labor and breaks down operations into constituent motions.
claims.supporting_excerpt: There can be hardly anything more alien or even more destructive to workmanship than teamwork, which actually is only a variety of the division of labor and presupposes the “breakdown of operations into their simple constituent motions.”

claims.claim: The exchange market served historically as the last public realm connected to the activity of homo faber.
claims.supporting_excerpt: Historically, the last public realm, the last meeting place which is at least connected with the activity of homo faber , is the exchange market on which his products are displayed.

definitions.definition: A variety of the division of labor that presupposes the breakdown of operations into simple constituent motions.

distinctions.distinction: Manufacturing society judges men as producers according to the quality of their products, whereas a laboring society judges men according to the functions they perform in the labor process.

output.segment_function: To analyze the relationship between workmanship, teamwork, commercial society, and the transition from homo faber to laboring society.
